questions.question: What does chapter 19 record?
options: The list of the cities of refuge
The land allotments for the remaining tribes
A great and fierce battle against the Canaanites
A song of thanks for the conquest
questions.answer: The land allotments for the remaining tribes

questions.question: Within whose territory did the tribe of Simeon receive its inheritance?
Joshua himself was given a city to inherit after all the tribes received theirs.
The inheritances were divided among the tribes by lot at _____.
The tribe of _____ received its inheritance within Judah's territory.
